questions.q: How does the course SITL project tell a route from a scenario?
options: The scenario stores coordinates, the route stores numbers
The route is points, the scenario is commands
It doesn't distinguish them at all
questions.explain: Separating data and logic: one route — many scenarios.

questions.q: The script hangs on wait_heartbeat(). Likely cause?
options: Wrong address or SITL isn't running
Not enough memory for the MAVLink buffer
questions.explain: The heartbeat is the first sign of a link.

questions.q: arm throttle is refused with PreArm right after SITL starts. What do you do?
options: Wait for the EKF to converge
questions.explain: The EKF needs 10–20 s to initialize; read the PreArm text.

questions.q: What does SITL NOT test honestly?
questions.explain: No motor noise and no mechanics; PIDs from SITL don't carry over.

questions.q: How do you simulate RC loss in SITL?
Which SITL port does MAVProxy usually take?
questions.explain: MAVProxy connects to SERIAL0 on 5760; your own clients go to 5762/5763.
